headlines.headline: Kiffin understands frustration as LSU's playoff hopes dashed
headlines.description: LSU coach Lane Kiffin said it was fair to question the team's 6-4 record this season after losing to Texas on Saturday, a defeat that likely knocked LSU out of playoff contention.

headlines.headline: Patience starting to run thin for head coaches in Week 11
headlines.description: Saturday didn't offer much that changed the season's complexion, but some coaches are coming under pressure.

headlines.headline: Arch Manning leads game-winning drive as Texas stuns LSU
headlines.description: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown pass along the left sideline with 3 seconds left, and Texas escaped Tiger Stadium with a victory over LSU on Saturday night.

headlines.headline: Wake Forest's post-blowout jab at SMU tops college football Week 11 trolls
headlines.description: Wake Forest dominated SMU on the gridiron Saturday -- and added insult to injury after the game.

headlines.headline: Louisville holds off UNC in game that ends with brawl
headlines.description: Louisville held off North Carolina 16-14 on Saturday night in a game that ended in a brawl and each of the teams having to be separated.

headlines.headline: Who are the winningest college football coaches of all time?
headlines.description: From Saban to Paterno, there are many legendary college football coaches. Who has the best career record? Check out who has the most wins now.

headlines.headline: Kentucky's CFP hopes take hit in upset loss to Gators, Philo
headlines.description: Florida quarterback Aaron Philo had 221 all-purpose yards and a touchdown to rally the Gators past No. 11 Kentucky 21-14 Saturday.

headlines.headline: No. 24 Boise State outlasts Oregon State, to host Pac-12 title game
headlines.description: Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and 3 TDs to help No. 24 Boise State outlast Oregon State 46-41 and wrap up the host spot in the Pac-12 title game.

headlines.headline: Grant Wilson delivers as Indiana boosts CFP, Big Ten hopes with win vs. USC
headlines.description: With Grant Wilson filling in at quarterback, No. 9 Indiana ramped up its offensive attack against USC and scored its best win of the season Saturday.

headlines.headline: No. 16 Oregon keeps CFP hopes alive with win over Michigan
headlines.description: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns, and No. 16 Oregon kept its slim chances for a spot in the College Football Playoff alive with a victory over struggling Michigan on Saturday.

headlines.headline: Watch best moments and top plays live from Week 11
Wake Forest strengthens CFP case with 'statement' win at SMU
headlines.description: No. 13 Wake Forest made a statement to the College Football Playoff selection committee with a 49-7 blowout of SMU on Saturday.

headlines.headline: Darian Mensah dices up ex-team Duke as Miami rebounds from first loss
headlines.description: Miami quarterback Darian Mensah diced up his former team Saturday, finishing with 382 yards and a touchdown in the 36-25 victory over Duke.

headlines.headline: Oklahoma AD rips Ole Miss, SEC; Rebels defend travel effort
headlines.description: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny ripped the SEC and Ole Miss for the "inexplicable" decision to move its game to Sunday, while the Rebels defended their travel efforts.

headlines.headline: Clemson QB Reynolds to have MRI on knee; backup Vizzina (ankle) also hurt
headlines.description: Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds is having an MRI on his injured knee, and backup Christopher Vizzina was sent to the hospital to evaluate his ankle.

headlines.headline: Vols lose top receiver Matthews to knee injury vs. Texas A&M
headlines.description: Tennessee leading receiver Mike Matthews suffered a right knee injury in the second quarter of Saturday's game at Texas A&M.

headlines.headline: Ohio State WR Smith sets Big Ten record, states Heisman case
headlines.description: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke yet another record, eclipsing the Big Ten mark for career receiving yards while also making his Heisman Trophy case in Saturday's win over Northwestern.

headlines.headline: Georgia commit, DL Marcellus Young Casario died after 'sudden medical emergency'
headlines.description: Marcellus Young Casario, a Georgia football commit, died Friday after experiencing a "sudden medical emergency," according to his high school.

headlines.headline: Tracking Ohio State WR Jeremiah Smith's record-setting 2026 season
headlines.description: Ohio State's superstar receiver has made breaking records a weekly occurrence this fall.

headlines.headline: Sources: Ole Miss RB Kewan Lacy to miss rest of season
headlines.description: Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy, who has one year of eligiblity remaining, will miss the rest of the season with a left shoulder injury, sources told ESPN.

headlines.headline: Sources: Rutgers star KJ Duff out for season after ankle surgery
headlines.description: KJ Duff, who projects as a first-round pick in the upcoming NFL draft, is expected to resume full football activities in January, sources said.

headlines.description: Before making a futures prediction after Week 10, let's look at three paths to conference championships.

headlines.headline: Oregon linebacker Teitum Tuioti out for season with knee injury
headlines.description: Outside linebacker Teitum Tuioti was carted off in the fourth quarter of the Ducks' win against Ohio State on Saturday.

headlines.headline: Brent Venables lauds Jason Witten as Sooners shine in Oklahoma playcaller's debut
headlines.description: In his debut as Oklahoma's offensive playcaller, Jason Witten, a former NFL tight end who coached high school in Texas last year, engineered an impressive Sooners attack that throttled No. 24 Florida in a 23-7 victory.

headlines.headline: Georgia flips script on Trinidad Chambliss, dominates Ole Miss in statement win
headlines.description: No. 2 Georgia finally contained Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss, holding him without a passing touchdown en route to a 42-7 blowout win over the No. 10 Rebels.

headlines.headline: 'We just refuse to go away': Sarkisian lauds Longhorns after 34-20 victory
headlines.description: In the wake of a 34-20 victory over Missouri on Saturday, Texas coach Steve Sarkisian lauded his Longhorns, who notched a fourth win over a top-20 opponent, telling reporters, "I believe there's a toughness in our organization that is kind of undeniable."

headlines.headline: Texas DE Colin Simmons, FBS sack leader, returns vs. Missouri
headlines.description: Texas edge rusher Colin Simmons, who leads FBS with 10.5 sacks and 16 tackles for loss this season, has returned after a 2-game absence for the No. 7 Longhorns.

headlines.headline: BYU star RB LJ Martin returns, plays vs. No. 3 Utah
headlines.description: BYU star RB LJ Martin, who hasn't played since Oct. 3 due to an ankle injury, will return for the Cougars' showdown vs. No. 3 Utah, coach Kalani Sitake told ESPN.

headlines.headline: Sources: QB Austin Simmons re-signs with Missouri for 2027
headlines.description: QB Austin Simmons, who is fourth in the SEC at 244 passing yards per game, has re-signed with Missouri for 2027, sources told ESPN, as his NFL stock rises.

headlines.headline: Source: Texas RB Hollywood Smothers done for season with torn MCL
headlines.description: RB Hollywood Smothers has a torn MCL, a source told ESPN, and will miss the rest of the season for the Longhorns, who are seeing their injury issues mount.

headlines.headline: Sources: LJ Martin trending toward return for BYU vs. Utah
headlines.description: BYU's LJ Martin is trending toward dressing and being available to play against Utah, sources told ESPN.

headlines.headline: LSU's Whit Weeks doubtful to return against Alabama
headlines.description: LSU star linebacker Whit Weeks, who missed the past four games with a fractured leg, is doubtful to play Saturday vs. Alabama.

headlines.headline: Breaking down the Heisman race: How Week 10 could change everything
headlines.description: Pamela Maldonado breaks down where things stand on the Heisman odds board with a new favorite taking over.

headlines.headline: Alabama 'headed in good direction' for key players to return from injury vs. LSU
headlines.description: Alabama is optimistic about the return of WR Ryan Coleman-Williams, CB Zabien Brown, C Racin Delgatty and DB Terrance Green for its game Saturday vs. LSU.

headlines.headline: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy returns nearly 6 months after being shot in leg
headlines.description: Missouri running back Ahmad Hardy returned to the field nearly six months after being wounded in the leg during a shooting at an outdoor concert.

headlines.headline: NFL scouts favor Drew Mestemaker as first QB taken in draft
headlines.description: In a midseason poll of 25 NFL scouts, Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker was the overwhelming choice to be the first quarterback selected in the 2027 NFL draft.
